title: [GMCP 203.018.06] Operations and evidence: Client connection runtime, caching, retries, and concurrency
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-018-06. Ship inspectable CLI, TUI or API state, configuration validation, bounded metrics/logs/traces, diagnostics, examples, migration and rollback guidance, incident runbooks, and reproducible evidence artifacts. Automate drift detection so a changed dependency or standard invalidates stale proof. Vector outcome: The client runtime pools only security-equivalent connections, honors ttlMs and cacheScope, invalidates on notifications, applies deadline and cancellation budgets, retries only safe operations with jitter and circuit breaking, and enforces per-server plus global concurrency and memory bounds. Reconnect, half-open, duplicate-response, slowloris, crash-loop and thundering-herd tests prove deterministic recovery without duplicate side effects. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
